evidence.quote: We propose a $35 million class fund with automatic payments to all identifiable members. Fees and expenses would be separately paid, subject to court approval
We propose a $35 million class fund with automatic payments to all identifiable members. Fees and expenses would be separately paid, subject to court approval
We can hold fees and expenses at $4.25 million, subject to court approval, if Brightline increases the class fund to $31.5 million.

summary: Plaintiff counsel raised fees alongside class relief, and the parties negotiated both before agreeing on the class fund. Hargrove expressly conditioned holding its fee figure on an increase in class recovery. The transcript does not clearly show counsel sacrificing class relief for fees, defense exploiting fee interests or playing counsel against each other, or a misleading court declaration.
